title: MedlinePlus says crawling may begin between about 6 and 9 months
summary: MedlinePlus says crawling may begin between about 6 and 9 months. The word on the page is may.
body: Under 6 to 9 months, the MedlinePlus infant page says crawling may begin. May begin is the page's wording. It does not say that most infants crawl by a set month, and it does not say that every infant crawls. Some babies scoot or roll instead. This card is that may-begin line from one US encyclopedia. It is not a diagnosis, and it does not give the age window used on a WHO chart.
